## ⚠️ READ THIS FIRST — evidence standard

**No role in this file was verified by loading its live posting.** The environment's network policy blocked outbound connections to every job board and career site throughout the search (`403 policy denial` on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, USAJOBS, and every employer domain tested). Web search worked, so all posting detail comes from **search-index copies of posting text**, with the source and date named on each entry's `Verification` line.

- **Postings may have closed.** Index snapshots lag reality by days to weeks. Entries carry `Posted:` dates where a mirror showed one.
- **Re-read the degree and license lines on the live page before applying** — those two screens matter most and index text is where stale quotes hide.
- **⚠️ AUDIT FLAG entries:** every wave was audited adversarially for rule violations and for *fabricated-looking* entries (a real risk when volume is demanded from a network-blocked session). Roughly 56 entries across the high-volume waves are flagged as possible fabrications, and ~230 carry some caveat flag — most commonly "US remote but Utah not explicitly confirmed." **Verify flagged entries first or skip them.**
- The known systemic caveat: most remote postings don't publish state lists, so *Utah eligibility is unconfirmed* for the majority of remote roles here. The T1 lane (Utah-explicit) exists precisely because its entries don't have this problem.

## Screening criteria applied (final version, as evolved through the engagement)

No securities licenses (Series 6/7/24/63/65/66/79/82 — quoted kills) · remote with Utah eligible or home-based field territory covering Utah/Mountain West/Denver region/national · **no office or hybrid roles anywhere, including Utah** · **no Utah-HQ employers** · **no title insurance companies** (category removed 2026-08-03) · no call-center/phone-queue work · 5+ years · no SDR/BDR/MSL · no accounting roles to perform · **no Merck (any division, incl. Verona Pharma) · no Human Interest** · sales AND non-sales, quota AND non-quota (see each entry's `Quota:` field) · degree language quoted exactly on every entry; hard-required listed but ranked lower.

## Federal / USAJOBS — Lanes F1–F3


**No qualifying roles this wave.** All three shards (F1 financial regulators, F2 retirement/benefits/business-facing agencies, F3 general USAJOBS remote sweep) returned zero includable announcements — an honest empty set, not a thin search. As of 2026-08-01, after the January 2025 federal return-to-office order, these agencies have essentially stopped posting "Remote job: Yes" announcements open to the public: everything live is either duty-station+telework (SEC, OCC, FinCEN, DOL, IRS), internal-only (OCC, NCUA, FDIC, USDA RD, USCIS, FCC, ASC, VBA), or genuinely remote but closed in May–July 2026. The strongest live leads sit in the Could-Not-Verify section below because one decisive field (the USAJOBS "Remote job" flag or hiring path) could not be read through the blocked proxy — several are time-sensitive and worth a 30-second human check.

# Excluded

_Every notable role screened out, with the specific disqualifier quoted, so the screening can be audited and challenged._

## Wealth technology & fintech distribution — Lanes A, B


*All disqualifier quotes below were captured from search-index snippets or job-board mirrors of the actual postings (careers.ta.com, Ladders, ZipRecruiter, Built In, etc.), not live pages — the wave had no working fetch channel. Kills rest on mirror evidence; judgment-call flags are preserved.*

**License kills**
- **Flourish (MassMutual) — Business Development Manager:** must "either have a Series 7 license or be willing to get a Series 7 within 90 days of joining, and either have a Series 63 license or be willing to get a Series 63 within 90 days of joining" plus "ability to pass a fingerprint background check to qualify as a fingerprinted person under FINRA." Also NYC-based. (job-boards.greenhouse.io/flourish/jobs/5620333004)
- **Flourish (MassMutual) — Director of Business Development:** "Either have a Series 7 or willingness to get a Series 7 within 60 days of joining." Eligible geography is "the western half of the US including Texas, Colorado, Arizona or California" (Utah not named). (job-boards.greenhouse.io/flourish/jobs/6014491004)
- **SEI — Business Development Director (Independent Broker-Dealer channel):** double kill — "Current NASAA Series 65 or Series 66 license or ability to acquire within 90 days" plus required "Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics or in a related field." Oaks, PA on the company posting (careers.seic.com/global/en/job/R0036013); Built In mirror shows remote at $100-120K.
- **Empower — Regional Sales Director (Greenwood Village / multiple):** "FINRA Series 6, 63 and applicable state insurance licenses" plus required "Bachelor's degree in Business or related field." (jobs.empower.com/job/greenwood-village/regional-sales-director/42743/81056544192)
- **LeafHouse — Sales Director (Austin, TX):** "FINRA licensing required including series 65 within 90 days of employment." Degree line was acceptable ("Bachelor's degree or three years of equivalent experience"), but license kills it; also Austin-based with no remote designation, 3-5 yrs skews junior. (JazzHR: leafhouse.applytojob.com)
- **iCapital (SIMON) — Regional Director - Structured Investments Distribution - Vice President:** "Series 7 and 63 licenses are required." Otherwise adjacent to Chad's background — license is the sole but fatal screen. (job-boards.greenhouse.io/icapitalnetwork)
- **iCapital (SIMON) — Structured Investments Platform Sales - Vice President / Senior Vice President:** "The position requires holding series 7 and 63 licenses."
- **DPL Financial Partners — Senior Membership Sales Consultant (Louisville, KY):** triple kill — "Bachelor's Degree in business or related field required"; "A Variable and Life Insurance License is required" (variable licensing entails FINRA registration); Louisville-based, not remote, not Utah.

#### Wave 8 audit findings

- **critical — Key Media, Media Sales Executive (Remote-US):** Violates constraint 7 and should be cut, not shipped — experience is "NOT CAPTURED," the sibling req in the same title family asks "Minimum 1-2 years," the comp figure is a ZipRecruiter header estimate, and the degree quote is borrowed from a different requisition.
- **critical — Circle, Business Development Director, Capital Markets, Credit:** Unresolved constraint-1 (securities license) risk on the role in the wave most likely to carry one; "FINRA Series 7, 63, or other regional securities licensing" appears as "a strong plus" on related Circle capital-markets reqs and the phrasing on this req was never read. Should be held until the qualifications block is read.
- **critical — wave-level, 13 of 14 roles:** Constraint 2 requires REMOTE with Utah explicitly among the listed eligible states; only Ontra meets that. Juniper Square (x2) hinges on an unenumerated 27-state footprint, Canoe's location line names California, and Grayscale/Fireblocks/Paxos/Circle (x2)/Key Media (x3)/DSG have no state roster at all.
- **critical — Canoe Intelligence, Account Executive, Wealth Management:** Live geography kill risk treated as a footnote — "Fully Remote – CA (West Coast)" is on its face a California-residency requirement and a constraint-2 disqualifier; the "West Coast and Mountain Region" counter-evidence describes the TERRITORY, and territory language never establishes residency eligibility.
- **critical — Addepar, Account Executive, Core:** Two independent constraint problems — (a) constraint 7, the "4+ years of experience in software sales" floor is below the 5+ bar; (b) constraint 2, Addepar's significant Salt Lake City office is used as a positive signal without checking the inverse risk that the req may be SLC office-based or hybrid, an explicit kill. Published range is also benchmarked to CO/CA/NY only with a floor as low as $108K.
- **moderate — wave-level corroboration methodology (Key Media x3, Addepar, Juniper Square x2, Paxos):** Repeatedly counts scraper mirrors and shared-feed job boards as "two independent sources"; most explicit is Paxos, where Oak HC/FT and Blockchain Capital share one Greenhouse id and are then treated as corroborating. Several "CORROBORATED" labels are single-source in substance.
- **moderate — Ontra, Senior Account Director, Growth Sales:** The ats field overclaims against the entry's own verification_note — it says "exact posting text captured via Remotive mirror," implying retrieval, while the note says every direct load 403'd and "NOTHING here was load-verified."
- **moderate — Key Media, Head of Sales (Media – Investments):** The load-bearing geography quote begins with a disqualifier — "Hybrid flexibility: work fully remotely from any major US city." Constraint 2 kills hybrid outright; the sentence is internally contradictory, was never read on the employer's own posting, the req is filed under New York, NY, is dated 4 April 2026 (~4 months stale), and SLC is not among the named examples.
- **moderate — Canoe Intelligence, Account Executive, Wealth Management (fit text):** Fit oversells and omits a disqualifying-adjacent gap — it calls him "simultaneously the buyer persona and an experienced seller into it" when he has sold investment product to advisors, not alt-investment data automation to family offices, and never mentions the req's "5+ year track record of success in fintech sales," which he does not have.
- **moderate — Diversified Search Group, Managing Director, DSG Corporate (fit text):** Fit misreads the requirement to manufacture a path in — the full sentence is "…executive search, leadership advisory or entrepreneurial business building WITH a proven track record in leadership advisory, business development, and client management," so the entrepreneurial route still demands a leadership-advisory track record he does not have; calling it the "Closest structural match found" while conceding "zero executive search experience" is internally inconsistent.
- **moderate — wave-level, 7 of 14 apply_urls:** Half the wave routes to aggregators or generic careers pages rather than employer requisitions (MediaBistro, ZipRecruiter, ontra.ai/careers, fireblocks.com/careers, jobs.oakhcft.com, workingnomads.com, glassdoor.com); combined with zero load-verification, no link is confirmed to resolve to a live req.
- **moderate — wave-level company concentration:** 7 of 14 roles come from three employers (Key Media x3, Juniper Square x2, Circle x2); three Key Media reqs with overlapping remote-US media-sales scope is closer to one opportunity presented three ways than three distinct leads.
- **moderate — wave-level freshness:** Unestablished on most of the wave and explicitly bad on some — Key Media Head of Sales ~4 months old; Key Media BDM has no visible post date; the DSG Glassdoor record has no readable capture date; Canoe's mirrors span Jan–Jul 2026; Fireblocks, Paxos and both Circle reqs have no captured posting date. Only Ontra (active 28 July 2026) and Juniper Square Titan (June–July 2026) are dated.
- **minor — Grayscale Investments, Director, Channel Marketing:** Residual license risk worth one check — channel-marketing seats at fund issuers supporting intermediary distribution sometimes carry a "Series 6/63 or ability to obtain" line, and Grayscale's VP National Accounts IS registration-gated; the absence rests on a targeted search returning no license line on a posting never loaded.
- **minor — Key Media, Head of Sales; Key Media BDM vs Media Sales Executive:** Possible duplicate requisitions inside the wave — two distinct MediaBistro IDs (3540321426 and 3539048002) for the Head of Sales role, one likely stale; and the BDM and Media Sales Executive may be the same underlying seat syndicated under two titles, never ruled out.
- **minor — Circle, Senior BD Director, Americas; Fireblocks, Sales Director, Enterprise:** Derived comp presented alongside quoted comp — Circle's "$290K–$362K total cash" is arithmetic on a disclosed 25% bonus target and Fireblocks' "(i.e., 50/50 split)" is an inference; both are labeled as derived but sit in the comp field beside quoted ranges.
- **minor — wave-level schema consistency:** fit_rank is populated only on the five V3 entries and absent from all nine V1/V2/V4 entries, so any cross-shard ranking keying on that field silently drops two thirds of the wave.
- **minor — Diversified Search Group (DSG Global):** Company naming risk — "DSG Global" is also the name of an unrelated publicly traded vehicle-technology company (DSGT); combined with a single undated Glassdoor record and an unretrieved requirements section, the entity or practice area may be misidentified.
- **minor — excluded-employer and re-source checks:** Clean on constraints 9 and 10 with one note — no Merck/Verona or Human Interest entities appear and no wave 1-7 company appears; Addepar is present but not on the waves 1-7 list, and the Core AE is a genuinely different, more junior req than the already-applied Sr. AE Enterprise, though confirmation that the two are not the same req family remains outstanding.

**Constraint violations flagged by the audit against roles that are nonetheless present in the ROLES section above — these must be reconciled before anything is sent to the candidate:** the audit says **Key Media — Media Sales Executive (Remote-US) should be CUT outright** (constraint 7, no seniority evidence at all); **Circle — Business Development Director, Capital Markets, Credit should be HELD** (unresolved constraint-1 license risk); **Canoe Intelligence — Account Executive, Wealth Management should be HELD** (the "Fully Remote – CA (West Coast)" line is a constraint-2 residency restriction, not a territory ambiguity); **Addepar — Account Executive, Core violates constraint 7** (4+ year floor) and carries an unchecked constraint-2 Salt Lake City onsite/hybrid risk; **Key Media — Head of Sales rests on a quote that literally begins "Hybrid flexibility,"** which constraint 2 kills on sight; and **13 of the 14 included roles cannot currently be certified against constraint 2** because only Ontra names Utah on a published hiring-state list. The audit's own recommendation: "Ontra, Fireblocks and Juniper Square Titan are the three worth the candidate's time first; everything below Circle Americas needs a recruiter call before any effort goes in."

#### Wave 9 audit findings

- **critical** — Rule 6 violation shipped as an included role: the entry labels degree_label REQUIRED and quotes "Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Communications, Business, Marketing, or related field"; a hard bachelor's on a SaaS/tech/services req is a DISQUALIFIER and Inspira is a benefits-administration services company, so it belongs in excluded[] until a human proves the line sits under Preferred. (Inspira Financial — Sr. Sales Executive, Arizona/Colorado/Utah)
- **critical** — Second rule 6 violation shipped as an included role: degree_quote is "...a B.A. or B.S. degree is required" with no equivalency clause, and the fit text itself concedes it is "a screening-stage hard stop" and "an ATS knockout" — reporting a known hard-gate role rather than excluding it inverts the rule. (Fidelity Charitable — VP, Business Development)
- **critical** — Fabricated apply_url: the verification_note admits "the specific Greenhouse job ID 5022908008 is INFERRED" and could not be opened to confirm it maps to this title; replace with the board root (job-boards.greenhouse.io/renpsg) or drop the role. (Ren — Head of Field Sales and Solutioning)
- **critical** — Mirror-shopping around a hard constraint: the apply_url is the Remotive mirror chosen because its wording says "anywhere from the United States," while the only employer-side posting is scoped "US - Remote FL / GA / NC / TN," a Southeast territory that EXCLUDES Utah; same pattern on comp, where the chosen mirror carries the richest band ($300K–$410K OTE). (Procore Technologies — Enterprise Account Executive)
- **critical** — Unresolved license exposure shipped as included: "This position will be an employee of Charles Schwab & Co., Inc." — the broker-dealer entity — for a role doing "proactive outbound sales activity" to advisors; compounded by Utah's absence from the named West territory, a single-sourced $100K–$130K base below floor, and a job ID suggesting the req is stale. (Charles Schwab — Senior Manager, Business Development, DAFgiving360)
- **critical** — Systemic geography failure across the wave: only Motive meets the "Utah explicitly among eligible states" standard on employer evidence, with Samsara clearing it via an SLC-specific req; Inspira names Utah in the territory title but its eligible-state list was lifted from a DIFFERENT req, and 13 of 16 roles carry "Utah eligibility is UNCONFIRMED" or an inference from "US-Remote" wording. (Affected: Fidelity x2, Ren, TIFIN, Schwab, EncorEstate, Supernova, Live Oak, Procore, ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Restaurant365, Crunchtime)
- **critical** — "No excluded[] array exists": the audit reports the wave shipped 16 inclusions and zero exclusion records, so there is no evidence any license-gated, hybrid or Utah-HQ role was screened and rejected. (Wave-level output structure)
- **moderate** — Evidence transplanting into structured fields: several degree_quote and experience values are lifted from SIBLING reqs and presented as belonging to the sourced req, with Supernova's "or an equivalent combination of education and experience" admitted as unconfirmed on the senior req and Live Oak's "or equivalent work experience" attributed to "related positions" while a sibling req requires a bachelor's outright. Open to alternate locations for the right candidate" is remote-tolerant, not remote; the entry also cannot establish whether "Director of Sales" and "Director, Advisor Sales & Enablement" are the same req and reports two irreconcilable comp bands. #### Wave 10 audit findings
- **CRITICAL — Envestnet — Strategic Relationship Management Director (INCLUDED, N1):** rule 5 quota violation — "functionally a sales seat in a non-sales wave and should be removed, not ranked": the posting itself says "end-to-end revenue ownership," "unlock cross-sell opportunities," "grow platform assets... to meet sales targets," and requires "at least 15 years in relationship management and strategic sales"; secondary kill: the application window closed 07/31/2026, two days before the wave date.
- **CRITICAL — Pentegra Retirement Services — Relationship Manager (INCLUDED, N1) — MISLABELED QUOTA_FLAG:** the N1 entry claims "NO QUOTA" while the N2 entry for the SAME posting quotes the opposite directly — "ultimate responsibility of overall client satisfaction and retention for all assigned clients" and "coordinating relationship management activities with sales and marketing teams"; the N1 label is factually wrong against the wave's own evidence and would have presented a retention-accountable seat as clean.
- **CRITICAL — Ascensus (Newport) — Relationship Manager (Non-Qualified) (INCLUDED, N2):** rule 2 geography kill — tagged "Remote, Pennsylvania, United States" and "Remote, Florida, United States," an affirmative two-state scope with Utah NOT among them ("Utah answer: NOT LISTED"); not an unresolved question but a remote scope that excludes Utah — prune.
- **CRITICAL — Milliman — Retirement Benefits Analyst (INCLUDED, N2):** rule 2 geography kill — remote is discretionary, not offered: "ideally based in Seattle, Washington, but remote work within the United States will be considered"; an office-preferred req, not a remote req, despite the wide $78,800–$145,130 band making it look like the best-paying clean role in the shard.
- **CRITICAL — Duplicates:** 7 redundant entries across 6 postings inflate the wave from 54 unique roles to 61 — T. Rowe Price Sr. Plan Compliance Consultant appears THREE times under the identical URL (employeebenefitsjobs.com/job/H177612) in lanes N1, N2 and N3; Ascensus CRM Client Services x2; Pentegra Relationship Manager x2; FuturePlan Retirement Plan Compliance Analyst x2; July Business Services Retirement Plan Consultant x2 (H177610); ACA Group Senior Principal Consultant x2 (same Himalayas URL) — and the duplicates carry CONTRADICTORY fields (see the Pentegra and Ascensus CRM quota findings).
- **CRITICAL — Entire wave (60 of 61 entries):** rule 2 not satisfied at the wave level — Guideline is the ONLY entry where the employer names Utah among eligible states (AZ, CA, CO, UT, WA + El Paso/Hudspeth TX); every other entry records "UTAH ELIGIBILITY UNCONFIRMED" or infers it from "Nationwide"/"anywhere in the United States" language; unresolved rather than confirmed violations, so not all pruned for a volume wave — but the wave must not be presented as having cleared constraint 2, and Utah eligibility is the first screen on all 60.
- **CRITICAL — Every role with a comp figure:** NO salary figure in this wave was read from a primary employer posting — every number traces to an aggregator or mirror rendering (RemoteRocketship, Ladders, Snagajob, RemoteLeaf, Built In, Jobgether, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, Lensa); several are presented in comp fields as if posting text: Milliman "$78,800 - $145,130" (single ZipRecruiter rendering), T. Rowe Retirement Plan Manager "$72,000 - $116,000" (single Snagajob mirror), Strongpoint "$80,000-$90,000" (single RemoteLeaf), Ascensus ERISA Consultant "$49K-101K" (Glassdoor's rendering), Broadridge "$85,000-$95,000" (single Ladders), Rain "$120K-$135K" (single Built In), Addepar Data Solutions "$93,000-$116,000" (single RemoteLeaf), Mercer Enablement "$93,500-$110,000" (single aggregator), Clasp "$100,000-$130,000" (single Jobgether). Treat all comp as unverified.
- **CRITICAL — ACA Group — Senior Principal Consultant (oCCO Lead) (INCLUDED, N3 and N4):** the $180,000–$200,000 figure is the highest in the wave and doing heavy ranking work, but is single-source and "may be attached to the Florida-tagged variant rather than the OCCO Lead req"; a Florida-tagged variant exists, meaning state-scoped variants are in play and a Utah-eligible variant may not exist at all; degree, license, and years-of-experience lines were ALL unretrievable — the thinnest evidence base in the wave attached to its most attractive number.
- **CRITICAL — Smarsh — Partner Success Manager (INCLUDED, N1):** not a mislabel (the quota_flag is honest) but a rule-intent problem — the role is DEFINED by revenue retention ("protecting and retaining recurring revenue across the partner channel ecosystem"; "owning the end-to-end renewal process for partner-managed recurring revenue (base ARR), ensuring high retention and predictable outcomes"); a renewal number almost certainly attaches — belongs in a clearly-labeled "retention-accountable" bucket, not alongside genuinely non-commercial seats.
- **MODERATE — Ascensus — Senior Relationship Manager, Retirement (INCLUDED, N2):** quota-adjacent and probably not a live req — "instrumental in promoting client retention, growth and product expansion" plus "actively involved in contract negotiations and Requests for Proposals (RFPs)" is commercial work by another name, and the posting reads as an evergreen talent-pipeline req ("cultivating a pipeline of proven talent") with possibly no headcount behind it.

- **MODERATE — Sub-5-year floors on nine included roles:** Advyzon (2+ yrs); Synergy Regulatory Compliance Consultant (2 yrs); Wealth.com Onboarding Specialist (2+ yrs); Mercer LMS & Instructional Designer (2 yrs ID minimum); Addepar Data Solutions Consultant (characterized as entry-level); JULY Client Service Manager (3+ yrs); Betterment Client Success Manager (3-5 yrs); Coinbase Compliance Lead Analyst (3-5 yrs); Ascensus ERISA Consultant (3-5 yrs). ## Maximum breadth I: remote-first employers, board sweeps, Mountain West field territories, insurance & payers — Lanes M1–M5

#### Wave 11 (M1–M5) audit findings

Auditor's overall verdict: ~129 entries, zero load-verified — the auditor independently confirmed the network claim (curl probes against the Crane Workday req, the GitLab Greenhouse req, the Later Himalayas listing, and the Zapier RemoteRocketship slug all failed), so "every 'quote' in this wave is a search-snippet reconstruction at best." The wave splits into Tier A (~55-65 entries, probably real — employer-idiomatic language and odd-precision numbers like GitLab's "incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary," Rocket Software's "$131,625.00 - $165,750.00," Jumio's "$105,855 to $148,197," Twilio's "$158,632.00 - $198,290.00," Airtable's "$155,015," plus correctly-encoded Workday location facets and Greenhouse ID conventions) and Tier B (~35-40 entries indistinguishable from invention — slug-only aggregator URLs derivable from title alone, the eleven-entry M3 Jobgether block being the worst concentration, and template strings repeated 20-30 times). The single hardest evidence: Hubbell req 103926 appears in M3 and M4 quoting mutually exclusive posting text — at least one agent produced quoted text it did not observe, which "should lower confidence in every unverified quote in this wave, including ones I placed in Tier A." Recommendation: "treat the wave as a lead list, not a findings list. Hard-kill Empower and Dynasty pending a license read. Drop Function Health, the two unnamed-employer entries, and the four duplicates. Quarantine all Tier B entries until a human resolves whether the URL 200s. Do not let any of this go to the candidate as 'found roles.'"

**Issues**
- **CRITICAL — Empower — Regional Sales Director (Mega):** near-certain securities-license disqualifier included as a live recommendation. Empower RSD roles standardly require FINRA Series 6/63 or 7/63, active or obtainable; the entry itself calls this "HIGHEST-RISK ITEM IN THIS LIST" and admits "Assume he would need to re-sit Series 6/63 or 7/63 to convert it" — an acknowledgment it violates constraint 1 (which excludes "obtain within X days" roles too). Should have been excluded with the license line quoted.
- **CRITICAL — Dynasty Financial Partners — Business Development Officer:** second near-certain securities-license disqualifier plus an unaddressed conflict of interest — Dynasty BDOs recruit breakaway advisors onto an RIA platform (Series 65 or 7/66 standard), and the candidate owns a competing RIA (Harvest Lane), so an outside-business-activity or exclusivity clause is a likely hard blocker. The entry flags both risks and includes the role anyway.
- **CRITICAL — AssetMark — Director, Strategic Accounts:** third unresolved license risk at a TAMP whose strategic accounts are broker-dealer and RIA home offices; the entry concedes "a Series 65/66 or 7 requirement is plausible and MUST be confirmed" yet ranks it "the single closest match in this shard" while its most likely disqualifier is unverified.
- **CRITICAL — Hubbell Incorporated — Territory Manager, Northwest & Rocky Mountain (M3 + M4):** quote-integrity failure. The same req 103926 appears twice at an identical apply_url asserting mutually exclusive posting text — M3: "the search results do not contain specific degree requirements for this position" and "exact year floor not visible"; M4: verbatim degree quote "Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or similar field is preferred, relevant experience will be considered" and verbatim "Minimum 5-7 years of related sales and territory management experience." Both cannot be true; the same Jobgether mirror is also cited with different slugs ("northwest-rocky-mountain" vs "normal-rocky-mountain"). At least one entry contains fabricated quoted text, contaminating confidence in every unverified quote in the wave.
- **CRITICAL — Function Health — Operations Manager, Member Experience:** no job posting URL — apply_url is a Dynamite Jobs category page and the note concedes "I did NOT obtain the individual job permalink." A role asserted with comp, location and skills but no locatable posting is not a finding; compounds with an unresolved phone-queue risk (constraint 4).
- **CRITICAL — four true duplicates inflating apparent volume:** (1) JumpCloud Enterprise Account Manager in M1 and M2 with conflicting comp ($225-250K vs $200-225K) and different "quoted" location sentences; (2) Zapier AE, Large Enterprise in M1 (Built In) and M2 (Ashby) with conflicting comp ($250K-400K vs $120-150K base/$240-300K OTE) and conflicting ATS attribution; (3) Zapier "Account Executive - Enterprise" admitted by its own entry to likely be the same req family as Large Enterprise; (4) Hubbell Territory Manager in M3 and M4 at the same URL.
- **CRITICAL — roles included with zero geography evidence** (inverting the burden constraint 2 imposes): Markforged Key Account Director, Automotive ("surfaced under a remote-keyword query only"); Notion Deal Desk Workflows Manager ("REMOTE STATUS IS UNCONFIRMED," hybrid-default company); Crane Company RSM Rocky Mountain ("Utah inclusion is inferred from Rocky Mountain, not confirmed"); Solenis Distribution Channel TSM ("remote/field basis not explicitly confirmed," Glassdoor tag Arizona); Qumulo Territory Account Manager (may be Seattle-office-tied). Each could be onsite or hybrid — an automatic kill.
- **CRITICAL — two entries where the actual employer is not named,** making constraints 3 (no Utah-HQ) and 8 (excluded employers) unverifiable by construction: Urrly — Senior Account Executive, Aviation & Compliance SaaS (recruiter for "a B2B airport-compliance SaaS client"); Jobgether — Regional Director of Sales, Wholesale Strategic Accounts, Western US ("end employer not named in the posting"; "Treat the employer as unknown until confirmed").
- **MODERATE — sub-5-year or below-bar seniority against constraint 6:** Deel Channel AE ("3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, channel, partnerships" — admitted "below your 5+ seniority bar"); Sellers Dorsey ("3–5 years of B2B hunter sales experience," topping out at the threshold); Twilio Security Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Analyst and Rainmaker Field Operations Specialist (titles flagged by their own entries as possibly below the bar); HMA ("3-5+ years," borderline).
- **MODERATE — non-US or non-Utah geography risk not resolved:** Later (Vancouver BC / SF — "verify the role is open to US (not Canada-only) residents"); StackAdapt (Toronto-headquartered); Megaport (Brisbane-headquartered, "a real risk the req is APAC-based rather than US"); Wpromote (URL slug contains "_fr_" — France-locale record); Medallion (indexed only as "Worldwide," "weaker evidence than an explicit US-remote statement"); Rackspace ("Houston, TX - Remote," Utah residency unconfirmed).
- **MODERATE — comp/degree/experience borrowed from a sibling req and used to populate the entry's own fields:** Regal Rexnord Utilities (degree REQUIRED from a line "NOT confirmed that this exact utilities req carries the same line"; comp "from the BDM family"); Skillsoft Compliance AE ($110-120K/$280-320K "attached to the Acquisition Account Executive listing"); GitLab FSI ("It is not certain that figure belongs to this exact req number"); Danaher (degree label PREFERRED from a line "indexed against a RELATED Danaher Senior Project Manager req"); Oldcastle APG (OR-EQUIVALENT from a "generic Oldcastle APG Territory Sales Manager description" that "may belong to a sibling territory posting"). Constraint 7 demands the exact quote from the role in question.
- **MODERATE — degree labels derived from aggregator "search summaries" rather than posting text:** Airtable labeled REQUIRED on "Bachelor's degree is required" from a summary, with the entry warning "aggregator summaries sometimes harden preferred into required"; Skillsoft SLED Growth labeled OR-EQUIVALENT from a summary and ranked up specifically because of that label — the one entry where degree language changes the ranking is the one where it is least verified.
- **MODERATE — internally conflicting comp within single entries, sometimes at 2x:** Cleerly ("$145,000 - $165,000" vs "$85,000 - $130,000"); Zapier Mid Market ("$140K–$230K in base" vs "OTE of $140K–$240K" vs RepVue base $100-105K — three irreconcilable figures); JumpCloud, Zapier Large Enterprise, and Twilio Senior Strategic AE each carry two conflicting numbers. A 2x spread means at least one source is describing a different req or is wrong.
- **MODERATE — structurally malformed or non-surfaceable URLs:** Crane's Workday link is missing the mandatory location segment between /job/ and the title that every other Workday URL in this wave has — "it reads as assembled, not observed"; Novartis's link ends in "/apply/autofillWithResume" on an it-IT locale path — a mid-application deep link that does not appear in search results and cannot be the URL the agent saw.
- **MODERATE — Hubbell's apply_url encodes "Foothill-Ranch-...-CA-92610"** — the posting's location facet is a California city, sitting awkwardly against both entries' remote-within-a-UT-inclusive-territory claim; Radancy URLs carry the real location facet, so hard-verify before trusting the Utah territory claim.
- **MODERATE — internal ID metadata contradicts claimed posting dates,** suggesting stale mirrors presented as current: Airtable (Built In 111566, a 6-digit ID consistent with roughly 2020, vs an asserted February 2026 date); Calyxo (Remotive 1293885, an order of magnitude below current-range IDs); Markforged TSM West (1793050) and Arc'teryx (3218117) similarly low. The wave elsewhere uses ID magnitude as an age heuristic but did not apply it to these.
- **MODERATE — widespread staleness not treated as disqualifying:** JumpCloud (Himalayas posted 2025-09-25, over ten months old); Upbound (2026-02-15); General Assembly (Jobgether ObjectID prefix "68cd" ≈ September 2025); Huntsman and Credit Acceptance (February 2026); GitLab New Business AE (April 5); Ajax (March 31); Zafran and United Flow (May 6); plus Automattic and Ridley Block. "A meaningful fraction of this wave is likely closed." (Also affected: GitLab Strategic AE and Commercial AE US West.)
- **MODERATE — unresolved call-center exposure against constraint 4:** Ethos Director of RevOps, Consumer (entry warns to "verify this is not an operations layer over a phone-sales floor, which would trip his call-center exclusion" and includes it anyway); Function Health raises the same risk. Neither was resolved.
- **MINOR — comp reported as third-party estimate rather than posting text:** Miro, Perforce Senior Enterprise AE, Grafana pipeline req, and Skillsoft Director of SLED Sales carry only RepVue/Glassdoor/Indeed aggregates; Oldcastle cites an algorithmic "predicted salary is between $43,200 - $72,000"; Huntsman cites a ZipRecruiter company-wide average; AssetMark cites Glassdoor crowd data. All explicitly labeled non-quotable — a completeness note, not a labeling failure.
- **MINOR — entries invoke a "$90K floor" that is not among this wave's stated hard constraints, then include roles beneath it:** Bitwarden ($55,000-$100,000 base); INDEVCO Mountain West ($60,900-$93,400); Arc'teryx ($78K-$98K); Solenis NV/UT/CO ($75,900-$106,260); Experian ($80,000-$130,000); Ridley Block (no figure at all — "competitive base salary is determined by experience"). Worth reconciling with the candidate.
- **MINOR — employer/ATS identity confusion:** CommandLink's URL is "himalayas.app/companies/ats-rippling/jobs/manager-revenue-operations" — the entry asserts the employer is CommandLink and Rippling is merely the ATS; Rippling is on the already-swept list, so a wrong attribution would also be a repeat-company issue. Flagged but not resolved.
- **MINOR — contradictory ATS attribution for the same employer across lanes:** M1 lists Zapier's ATS as Greenhouse for three reqs; M2 lists it as Ashby with an Ashby UUID for what is likely the same req — at least one lane guessed. (Affects all four Zapier entries.)
- **MINOR — weak or contradictory corroborating sources presented as independent confirmation:** Zapier Mid Market cites euremotejobs.com (a European board) for a US-remote req; Oldcastle cites Lensa and Neurelis rests entirely on Lifelancer — scraper/lead-gen sites with high ghost-listing rates; Solenis Distribution Channel rests solely on a Glassdoor mirror the entry itself notes is "frequently stale."
- **MINOR — probable intra-company duplicates not reconciled:** GitLab "Program Manager, Enablement Content" vs "Program Manager, Field Enablement Content" ("two reqs or one renamed"); the two Solenis entries cover heavily overlapping territories (NV/UT/CO and UT/CO/AZ/NM) and may be one req; Bitwarden's own note reports three career IDs for the same title (7659179003, 6510250003, 6650360003).

**Suspected fabrications** (auditor's reason for each)
- **Crane Company — Regional Sales Manager - The Rocky Mountain Region:** malformed Workday URL — every other Workday link in the wave correctly includes the location segment between /job/ and the title (AssetMark "job/remote/", Credit Acceptance "job/utah--remote/", College Board "job/remote---usa/", Symbotic "job/USA-Remote--Travel/"); this one has none, "which is what URL assembly from a title produces." Title and slug disagree ("The Rocky Mountain Region" vs "Rocky-Mountain---Canada-Region"); zero posting content retrieved; the entry's own note calls it "the thinnest-evidence entry in included[]."
- **Novartis — Allergy Territory Account Specialist – Spokane/Salt Lake City – Remote:** the apply_url is an Italian-locale, mid-application deep link ("novartis.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/it-IT/.../apply/autofillWithResume") never returned by a web search — only reachable after clicking Apply inside a session, so the claim it "surfaced by WebSearch" is inconsistent with the artifact produced. No comp, experience, or degree retrieved; Salt Lake City in the title is maximally convenient for this candidate.
- **Function Health — Operations Manager, Member Experience:** no posting URL exists in the entry (a Dynamite Jobs category page; the note concedes the permalink was never obtained), yet the entry supplies a precise comp band ("$120k - $165k per year"), a skills list, and a remote designation — "asserting specific posting attributes while admitting you never located the posting is the exact fabrication pattern to look for."
- **Zapier — Account Executive - Enterprise:** completely content-free — no comp, experience, degree, requirements, or location text; the URL is a RemoteRocketship slug derivable from company + title with no ID; the entry itself says it is a duplicate-family posting to the Large Enterprise req — "most likely a phantom generated by pluralizing a real Zapier req into a third listing to pad volume."
- **Hubbell Incorporated — Territory Manager - Northwest & Rocky Mountain (Remote):** two entries cite this identical req and URL while quoting mutually exclusive posting text — one was invented; the same Jobgether mirror slug is rendered differently ("northwest" vs "normal"), "a corruption you get from reconstructing a URL from memory rather than copying it." The wave's only demonstrable case of fabricated quoted text.
- **Jobgether (end employer not named) — Regional Director of Sales - Wholesale Strategic Accounts - Western US:** suspiciously tailored — the title contains the literal word "Wholesale" (the candidate's exact fifteen-year specialty) and the location line names Salt Lake City first among preferred bases; employer unnamed so nothing can be checked; Jobgether posting client roles on its own Lever board is a known ghost-listing pattern; no comp/experience/degree — "the highest-prior fabrication profile in the wave."
- **Twilio — Senior Strategic Account Executive (Regulated Verticals):** the parenthetical vertical suffix breaks Twilio's own title convention, documented in the same wave as numbered levels ("Strategic Account Executive 3/4", "Account Executive 4"); a one-off "(Regulated Verticals)" variant naming the candidate's single strongest differentiator, then called "arguably the single strongest fit in this shard," "reads as a title reverse-engineered from the candidate profile." Comp also quoted two incompatible ways ($158,632-$198,290 vs $159K-$220K).
- **Markforged — Key Account Director, Automotive:** no geography evidence whatsoever — "surfaced under a remote-keyword query only," remote status never stated; no comp/experience/degree; a Greenhouse ID is present but with nothing else observed there is no way to distinguish it from an ID pattern-matched to the company's other reqs.
- **Notion — Deal Desk Workflows Manager:** entirely content-free apart from the title; "REMOTE STATUS IS UNCONFIRMED AND IS THE FIRST THING TO CHECK" at a company acknowledged as hybrid-default; an Ashby UUID is unguessable if real but nothing corroborates it, and the title "is a plausible-sounding generic that a model would construct from 'Deal Desk Manager' + a differentiating word."
- **GitLab — Senior Manager, Customer Trust and Security Governance:** the URL slug ends "washington-remote" while the entry's title claims "United States Remote" — RemoteRocketship slugs encode the posting's location, so a slug/title mismatch means either the slug or the title was supplied by the model rather than read. No comp/experience/degree retrieved; also the entry singled out as "the most interesting non-sales role in the shard" for this candidate.
- **GitLab — Director, Customer Experience Strategy:** nothing retrieved beyond a constructible RemoteRocketship slug — "Only the title and remote-US scope were visible; no requirements or comp text was retrievable." Company plus title suffices to generate this exact URL without loading a page.
- **GitLab — Major Account Executive:** same profile — slug-only URL with no ID, no comp for the req itself (a sibling's range substituted with a warning), no experience floor, no degree, no location text beyond inferred policy; GitLab over-represented at nine entries in one lane, several content-free.
- **Deel — Account Executive - Enterprise:** "Only the title and US scope were retrievable; no comp, experience or degree text was available"; slug-only URL; appears immediately after a well-evidenced Deel entry — "the classic pattern of one real find being extended into a second, invented sibling."
- **Perforce Software — Director, Sales:** "Only the title and remote-US scope were retrievable"; slug-only URL; no comp/experience/degree/territory; conceded to be "the weakest of the three Perforce entries" and included "for breadth" — "it exists to raise the count, not because anything was verified."
- **Twilio — Security Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Analyst:** slug-only URL with no comp/experience/degree/state-exclusion list — notable because every other Twilio entry in the wave carries a specific exclusion list, so lacking any Twilio-idiomatic text while sharing the employer is anomalous; also the only Twilio entry mapping to the candidate's compliance angle, "where invention pressure would be highest."
- **Skillsoft — Director of SLED Sales:** slug-only URL; no comp for the req (RepVue data for a different, more junior role substituted), no degree quote (a sibling req's line offered as "inference only"), no experience floor; "the one-sentence role description is generic enough to be generated from the title alone."
- **Later — Sr Director of Partnerships:** comp of "285k-350k USD" is implausibly high for a partnerships director at a SaaS of Later's size, and an exact band paired with an exact "7 years minimum required" floor is "suspiciously complete for a session that could load nothing"; the Himalayas URL carries a "?pos=19" search-results-position artifact that would not normally survive into a canonical apply link. Flagged as the wave's "highest headline comp, which is where fabrication pays off most."
- **Screenverse — Vice President, Sales:** base $200,000-$250,000 with OTE $400,000-$450,000 at a small DOOH network is well outside plausible range for the company's scale; single-source Remotive, no corroboration, no experience floor, no degree, no state list; the entry's own hedge about the low-numbered posting ID "concedes the record looks anomalous."
- **Muck Rack — VP, Sales:** "USD 400,000 - 450,000 per year" is the highest figure in the M2 lane and rests on a single Remotive snippet; the geo-neutral-comp detail is genuinely characteristic of Muck Rack — a mixed case — but a top-of-wave number with no second source, no experience floor and no degree line warrants confirmation before it reaches the candidate.
- **CrowdStrike — Global Alliances Manager:** part of an eleven-entry Jobgether block in M3 sharing one profile — aggregator-only URL, "original ATS not identified in snippet," no comp/experience/degree/state list, identical boilerplate; for this entry the note admits "the underlying CrowdStrike req number was NOT visible" — no evidence ties the Jobgether record to an actual CrowdStrike opening.
- **FICO — GSI Global Alliances Manager - TCS:** same Jobgether block; no native ATS link, no comp/experience/degree; the hyper-specific "TCS" qualifier "is the kind of concrete detail that makes a listing feel observed while being trivially generatable," and the entry is rated a "genuinely relevant vertical" for the candidate — the direction invention would bias toward.
- **AireSpring — Channel Manager Telecom/Managed Services Provider - Remote (Telecom):** Jobgether-only; the quoted geography ("a remote role open to candidates anywhere") is "the single most permissive possible answer to the wave's hardest constraint, sourced from an aggregator snippet with nothing else attached"; no comp/experience/degree; the redundant "(Telecom)" suffix "reads like slug-to-title reconstruction."
- **DigitalOcean — Director, RevOps Systems & GenAI:** Jobgether-only, no native Greenhouse link, no comp/experience/degree/state list; "the title bolts a trend term onto a standard function, which is a common shape for a generated title"; the entry itself calls it "the weakest fit in the included list," contributing count without conviction.
- **TeleTracking Technologies — Revenue Operations (Rev/Ops) Manager:** Jobgether-only with nothing retrieved; "the parenthetical '(Rev/Ops)' is an odd, non-standard rendering that no employer would publish alongside the spelled-out term in the same title — it reads as a model disambiguating for itself rather than reproducing a real posting title." Seniority unverified against the 5-year bar.
- **Ridley Block Operations (Alltech Family of Companies) — Account Manager:** the only entry in the wave whose quoted location line names Utah verbatim ("fully remote and open to candidates residing in Wyoming, Idaho, Utah, or Montana"), labeled "BEST GEOGRAPHIC MATCH IN THE SHARD"; rests on a slug-only alltech.com URL with no req ID and — tellingly — supplies no comp figure at all, "which is the field hardest to invent plausibly. A too-convenient geography quote paired with a conspicuous gap exactly where invention is riskiest is a pattern worth confirming before trusting."
- **Qumulo — Territory Account Manager – Arizona, New Mexico, Utah, Colorado:** nothing retrieved except a title that itself contains the winning geography; no comp/experience/degree, remote status unconfirmed — may be "Seattle-office-tied," an automatic kill. "A title that spells out four states including Utah, with no other observed content, may be a territory list assembled to satisfy the constraint."
- **Solenis — Distribution Channel Territory Sales Manager - UT, CO, AZ & NM:** rests entirely on a Glassdoor mirror conceded to be "frequently stale"; no comp/experience/degree, no confirmed remote basis; territory overlaps heavily with the other Solenis entry, and it is described as "the closest analogue in this shard to his DCIO work" — "a second, better-fitting variant of an already-found req, with strictly less evidence, is a likely duplication-by-elaboration."
- **Airtable — Account Executive, Strategic Accounts (Remote):** mixed signals worth resolving — the "$155,015" precision reads genuinely observed, but the Built In ID (111566) is 6-digit, consistent with roughly 2020, contradicting the claimed February 2026 date; the URL uses a "/job/sales/" category segment no other Built In link in this wave has; and the hard "Bachelor's degree is required" label — the field that most affects the candidate's ranking — comes from a search summary, with the entry itself warning summaries harden "preferred" into "required."
- **Urrly (recruiting for an unnamed B2B airport-compliance SaaS client) — Senior Account Executive – Aviation & Compliance SaaS (Remote):** end employer unnamed, so no constraint can be checked against it; the niche is oddly precise ("airport-compliance SaaS") and combines the candidate's compliance differentiator with a clean We Work Remotely slug carrying no ID; comp ("$100K–150K base + uncapped commissions (OTE ~$250K+)") is complete while degree, experience years, and state list are all absent — "an uneven evidence profile that suggests the comp string was constructed to make the entry viable."

## Maximum breadth II: consumer & CPG, manufacturing & distribution, business services, broad B2B SaaS, nonprofit & obscure — Lanes M6–M10


*Session-wide egress block: every shard in M6–M10 lost its research instrument. WebSearch was already
at the session cap when these shards started — `"Web search was not performed: this session has used
its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)."` — and WebFetch is independently blocked by
organization egress policy, returning HTTP 403 Forbidden on every attempt (pepsicojobs.com,
duckduckgo.com/html, job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards.greenhouse.io, himalayas.app). The M9 agent
confirmed the cause at the proxy rather than guessing: `curl -sS "$HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status"`
showed `recentRelayFailures` with kind `"connect_rejected"`, detail `"gateway answered 403 to CONNECT
(policy denial or upstream failure)"` for job-board hosts including startup.jobs,
www.remoterocketship.com and careers.fiveelms.com. Consequence: every entry below is an **UNSWEPT
TARGET, not a lead** — no posting was seen, no title confirmed, no URL confirmed, and no evidence
exists that any named organization currently has a qualifying opening.*

#### Wave 11 (M6–M10) audit findings

**Audit issues touching M6–M10: NONE.** All 24 entries in the audit's `issues[]` name affected roles
that fall in lanes M1–M4. The audit's own scope statement confirms why: it reviewed *"Roughly 129
entries across four lanes, zero of them load-verified"* — four lanes, because M5–M10 contributed zero
entries to audit. No issue text in the audit object mentions M6, M7, M8, M9 or M10.

**Suspected fabrications falling in M6–M10: NONE.** All 29 entries in `suspected_fabrications[]` are
M1–M4 roles (Crane Company, Novartis, Function Health, Zapier, Hubbell, Jobgether, Twilio ×2,
Markforged, GitLab ×3, Deel, Perforce Software, Skillsoft, Later, Screenverse, Muck Rack, CrowdStrike,
FICO, AireSpring, DigitalOcean, TeleTracking Technologies, Ridley Block Operations, Qumulo, Solenis,
Airtable, Urrly). Because M6–M10 emitted zero roles, there is nothing in these lanes for the auditor to
have flagged, and no ⚠️ AUDIT FLAG applies to any role in the ROLES section above.

**The one audit finding that does bear on these lanes — and it is corroborating, not adverse:** the
audit summary records that *"no Utah-HQ employers slipped through (none of
USANA/Nu Skin/Alsco/MasterControl/Instructure/NetDocuments/Filevine/Entrata/Canopy appear)"*. That is
independent confirmation that the constraint-3 rule held wave-wide, and it is exactly the rule the six
M6–M10 exclusions above document — USANA and Nu Skin (M6), Alsco (M8), MasterControl and Instructure
(M9), plus the preemptive Swire Coca-Cola USA flag (M6). Note that the auditor verified these employers
are *absent from included lists*; it did not independently verify the HQ locations asserted in the
exclusions, which the M8 and M9 agents both flagged as needing human confirmation.

**Cross-cutting caveat the audit raises that a re-run of M6–M10 should inherit:** the auditor
independently confirmed the network claim — *"curl probes against the Crane Workday req, the GitLab
Greenhouse req, the Later Himalayas listing, and the Zapier RemoteRocketship slug all returned
connection failures"* — which corroborates the M6–M10 agents' account of the blocker rather than
contradicting it. The audit's closing recommendation, *"treat the wave as a lead list, not a findings
list,"* applies with even more force here: M6–M10 produced not even a lead list, only a target list.

#### Wave 14 audit findings

**Issues:**
- CRITICAL — Zero load-verified postings in the entire wave: every detail page 403'd; all fields (comp, quotes, dates, remote scope, liveness) are secondhand from search snippets and mirrors, so license and office/hybrid screens ran on partial text for all 45 entries the auditor counted.
- MODERATE — Fidelity VP Regional Account Executive 401K Sales: near-certain securities-license kill listed anyway (Fidelity 401(k) AE roles virtually always require active Series 7/63); captured title-only, disqualifying line never seen — hold or prune pending verification.
- MODERATE — Focus Financial Partners RVP Business Development: three unresolved kill-risks stacked — high-probability Series 65/IAR requirement, city-tagged mirror variants suggesting possible co-location with Fidelity Investor Center sites (geography-rule fail), and a direct OBA conflict with his own RIA.

#### Wave 15 audit findings

- CRITICAL — ID.me (T3 + T4): intra-wave duplicate — the same Greenhouse req (job-boards.greenhouse.io/idme/jobs/7768657003) appears in both shards with identical title and contradictory degree labels (T3: NOT MENTIONED; T4: OR-EQUIVALENT via exact-phrase search); consolidate to one entry and resolve the degree label — the contradiction also discredits the T4 labeling method.
- CRITICAL — ZeroTier — Sales Director: Financial Markets: rule 2 violation as quoted (NO office/hybrid) — the entry itself quotes "A hybrid role (remote/on-site) located anywhere in the continental United States"; "located anywhere" suggests on-site may mean customer visits, but under the hard constraint the hybrid quote is a kill unless the live posting explicitly clarifies no office anchor.
- MODERATE — Onco360; StormTrap; Celerion; (Chainguard to confirm): rule 6 (5+ years credited) violations — Onco360 requires "at least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales management" (verified via aggregators); StormTrap requires "at least 3 years of experience in technical sales"; Celerion requires "Minimum 3-5 years of pharmaceutical/CRO sales experience" and is not self-flagged; aggregator listings (Outscal) show the Chainguard Utah seat as "3+ years experience" — confirm on the live req.
- MODERATE — Chainguard — Enterprise Account Executive - Utah (Salt Lake City): rule 2 ambiguity on a T1 headline seat — third-party listing (Outscal) tags it as "a hybrid position in Utah," conflicting with the entry's remote-first characterization; posting existence, title, and URL verified, but remote-vs-hybrid language must be confirmed on the live Greenhouse page before treating as compliant.
- MODERATE — Pathward, N.A. — Managing Director, Business Development (Working Capital): rule 2 unproven and quote contains "Hybrid" — only location evidence is company boilerplate ("Hybrid, remote-office company") plus a Glassdoor Remote tag on a sibling req, not this req; remote status of req 6011392004 is unverified.
- MODERATE — Carr Talent Acquisition — Director Customer Success: unscreenable entry — recruiting-agency listing with unnamed end employer cannot be checked against the Utah-HQ exclusion list or excluded employers (Merck, Human Interest, title insurers); prune or hold until the employer is identified — the entry itself concedes it "could even be an excluded company."
- MODERATE — Togetherwork — Director Business Development (Remote- US Based): req posted on the "twinternal" (Togetherwork Internal) Greenhouse board — may be internal-mobility only and closed to external applicants; verify a public version exists before counting this as a sourced role.
- MODERATE — T4 shard (YipitData, Rockbot, Employ, Pallet, ID.me, Fieldguide, ZeroTier, SalvoHealth, ezCater, JLL, BeiGene): rule 7 requires an EXACT degree quote; the T4 OR-EQUIVALENT labels rest on exact-phrase search hits ("or equivalent work experience" / "or equivalent experience") whose full sentences were never captured — the ID.me T3/T4 contradiction proves the method can mislabel, and the JLL entry admits its phrase may belong to a different posting; downgrade all T4 OR-EQUIVALENT labels to unverified pending live-posting quotes.
- MODERATE — Smartsheet — Client Services Director: degree label wrong and a hard screen missed — live listing requires "BS degree or equivalent" (should be OR-EQUIVALENT, not NOT MENTIONED) and "12+ years of experience carrying a services sales quota for enterprise customers, closing Professional Services opportunities >$250k" — a domain screen Chad likely fails; verification did confirm the Built In URL (3716817) is the Smartsheet role and the $130K-$168K comp matches.
- MODERATE — WorkWave — Enterprise Account Executive: quoted comp presented as posting language could not be corroborated — the entry quotes "$95,000 - $125,000 and an OTE of $190,000-$250,000," but the only comp found in verification is for the Florida sibling req ($120K-$125K base / $240K-$250K OTE), and the entry's Lever UUID (5525aad1-...) does not match the currently indexed Enterprise AE req (e3eeec8d-...); SLC eligibility is corroborated via LinkedIn/JobTarget, but URL and figures may be stale or transposed.
- MODERATE — RingCentral — Strategic Account Executive: weakest rule-2 case in the wave — Utah is absent from the quoted nine-state list; even if it is pay-transparency rather than eligibility language, companies that enumerate those states frequently hire only in them — treat as possibly ineligible, not merely unconfirmed.
- MODERATE — T2 shard (InvestCloud, Matillion, Perficient, Workiva, Wellhub, Philips, uConnect, OpenX, Strategic Education, Fortune Brands (Moen), Supermetrics, 829 Studios, Cencora, U.S. Bank): sourced almost entirely from Himalayas aggregator pages used as apply URLs (no ATS links) — staleness and detail-drift risk; several entries show only bare "Remote" without even US-scope language — below the "bare US remote" floor rule 2 tolerates as unconfirmed; Moen is additionally single-source after a failed direct corroboration.
- MINOR — Onco360 — Regional Sales Business Director - Mountain West: verified real via aggregators (BeBee/JobLeads, $140K and 3-year language confirmed) but the postings date to March 2026 with no live req found on Onco360/BrightSpring's own site — high likelihood the role is filled; combined with the sub-5-year violation, prune unless the live req resurfaces.
- MINOR — ezCater — Strategic Account Executive (Remote) [T4]: comp tops out at the $150K OTE floor and the entry admits attribution between the two ezCater reqs (5123094007 vs 4266134007) "was not fully clean" — borderline include with cross-contaminated data.
- MINOR — Ferguson (Millennium / RP Lighting) — National Accounts Manager: captured URL is the /apply path (self-noted), and the preferred geography ("ideally... Georgia, Florida, Texas, Carolinas, or Arizona") makes Utah a disfavored residence despite the "anywhere in US" language — low practical odds.
- MINOR — Levanta — Strategic Sales Executive, New Marketplace Partnerships: state list verified live (NY, WA, CA, FL, TX, OH, UT, MI, PA, MA — Utah confirmed), but the entry's inclusion of "DC" was not reproduced in verification; quote the exact list from the posting as the entry itself instructs.
- MINOR — Glean — Enterprise Account Executive (Remote - Utah): verification superseded entry data favorably — posting confirmed live with OTE $235K-$285K, requires 6+ years of sales experience (rule 6 satisfied) and candidates "required to reside in the state of Utah" (user resides in Sandy, UT — compliant); entry's "experience not stated" should be updated.
- MINOR — Imagine Pediatrics — Director, Partner Success: posting reported active "as of June 2026" — two months stale at audit date; confirm live before ranking.

**Suspected fabrications**

- ID.me — Director, Business Development (remote) [T4 entry]: the OR-EQUIVALENT degree quote ("or equivalent experience") exists only as an uncaptured exact-phrase search hit and is directly contradicted by the T3 entry for the identical req, which reports NOT MENTIONED. Most likely a search-method artifact attributed to the posting rather than text actually on it.
- JLL (Jones Lang LaSalle) — Vice President, Business Development: the entry itself concedes that the "equivalent combination of education and experience" line may have come from a different posting in the same search results. The degree quote is therefore unattributed to req REQ493588 — treat it as unsourced until the live posting is pulled.
- BeiGene (BeOne Medicines) — Senior Director or Executive Director, Strategic Field Enablement: "GED or equivalent" is a bare two-word fragment with no surrounding sentence, matched by exact-phrase search. It is common Workday education-field boilerplate and may not describe this role's actual requirement; using it to label the posting degree-friendly (OR-EQUIVALENT) overstates the evidence.
- WorkWave — Enterprise Account Executive: neither the Lever UUID in the apply_url nor the quoted comp band ($95K-$125K base / $190K-$250K OTE) could be corroborated; the currently indexed WorkWave Enterprise AE req has a different UUID and the only comp found (FL sibling req) differs materially. Possibly a stale/removed repost, or figures transposed from another req — not necessarily invented, but the entry's most load-bearing details failed verification.
- Fortune Brands (Moen) — Remote Director of Strategic Partnerships & Growth: single-source — every detail (title, comp "$105,000 to $150,000", remote status, affinity/insurance scope) rests on one Himalayas aggregator rendering, and the sourcing agent's own direct company search failed to corroborate. Honest disclosure, but the posting's existence on Fortune Brands' own ATS is unproven.

*Audit spot-check summary: wave contains 71 entries (70 unique — ID.me duplicated across T3/T4); 16 of the highest-risk claims were checked against live indexes and 15 corroborated, including every quoted T1 state list (Charter Impact, Adswerve, Levanta, and CharterUP — whose list was confirmed on the actual Enterprise Events req, upgrading it from cross-req extrapolation), all three Utah-explicit AE titles (Glean, Chainguard, Rapid7), and the precise comp quotes at YipitData ($350K OTE), Rockbot ($175-215K), Employ ($160,699-$200,874), Smartsheet, and Onco360. No securities-license, Utah-HQ, excluded-employer (Merck/Human Interest/title insurance), call-center, SDR/BDR, or prior-find violations exist anywhere in the wave.*

# Audit notes

_From the completeness critic on the main sweep. Per-wave audit findings appear at the end of each wave's Could-Not-Verify section._


- **critical** — Zero included roles across all shards: every verification session had a total egress block (403 on all hosts incl. example.com) plus an exhausted shared WebSearch budget; the deliverable is a re-run queue of ~60 unverified leads, not a vetted job list, and must be re-run with working egress before going to the candidate.
- **critical** — Lanes C (~47 pharma companies), D (29 device/diagnostics companies), and E (~28 Utah SaaS companies) received ZERO screening — not even discovery ran (budget drained by earlier shards); these are the degree-relaxed lanes and likely the most accessible segment; empty excluded[] lists there carry no market signal.
- **critical** — The reverify pass confirmed liveness of NONE of the 14 prior pipeline roles, and 4+ show active closure/retitle risk (FMG Enterprise AE absent from index, Wealthbox Enterprise AE absent, Gridline apparently retitled to "Director, RIA Partnerships", Envestnet posting family window closed 2026-07-31) — applying from the old list risks dead or downgraded reqs.
- **moderate** — No disqualification quote anywhere comes from a live posting: every license/degree/geography quote is from search-index snippets or mirrors (careers.ta.com, Ladders, ZipRecruiter, Built In); kills are probably safe but the candidate must be told all exclusions rest on mirror evidence.
- **moderate** — Cross-shard contradiction: Apex Fintech "Sales Director, Advisory" excluded in A2 (hybrid NJ/Austin) but listed as B2's #2 priority prospect with remote status unknown — reconciled in this fragment as EXCLUDED (office-hybrid) with the conflict noted.
- **moderate** — Internal contradiction on Envestnet BD Director – RIA (17857841): A2 parks it as a top re-check while reverify reports its application window closed 2026-07-31 — closure flagged prominently here (kept in CNV, not ROLES).
- **moderate** — ~9 leads carry aggregator URLs instead of direct employer/ATS links (iCapital West RD via themuse.com, Apex via builtin.com, Broadridge via builtinnyc.com, Nitrogen via a Glassdoor company page, Clearwater via Glassdoor, Enfusion via purpose.jobs, Arcesium via startup.jobs, InvestCloud via builtinla.com, eMoney Advisory ESE via mediabistro.com).
- **moderate** — Trust & Will Sr AE II (the best functional fit in lane A2, $250-300K remote) was excluded on a state-eligibility list quoted from the careers page and a SIBLING posting, not the req itself (trustwill/jobs/4110450009 never loaded) — false-negative risk on the strongest finance-lane role.
- **moderate** — Zinnia VP Partnerships & Alliances ($270-300K remote; Utah IS an eligible Zinnia remote state) was excluded on a mirror-sourced hard-degree quote; if the live line reads "preferred" it becomes the #1 role in the lane — exclusion should be treated as provisional.
- **moderate** — Practifi Account Manager retained as a lead despite being a Client-Success-labeled post-sale role, inconsistent with the GeoWealth exclusion for the same pattern — resolve (both leads or both kills) before delivery; Central/Eastern TZ preference is an added soft negative.
- **minor** — Duplicate exclusion: Betterment "Senior Manager of Advised 401k Sales" appeared in both A1 and B1 (deduplicated in this fragment).
- **minor** — Unresolved eMoney dedupe cluster: Jobvite req oq7RxfwF, sibling req oey5vfw6 (identical title), and the Mediabistro-sourced "Advisory Enterprise Sales Executive - Growth Accounts" may be one, two, or three distinct roles — the candidate could triple-count one opportunity.
- **minor** — One comp estimate slipped in against the never-estimate rule: Kestra M&A BD Specialist "est. $80K-$120K" — should be treated as "not disclosed" (role dies on seniority/geography regardless).
- **minor** — Lane E contained a bookkeeping row masquerading as a company ("Lendio (Lehi) — duplicate guard") — removed in this fragment.
- **minor** — URL plausibility could not be verified live from any session (the audit session was also fully egress-blocked); formats are structurally consistent with the claimed ATS platforms so nothing looks fabricated, but every URL — including the priority click-through list — is unconfirmed.
